note.after_visit_summary: Today we found rough, scaly spots on your scalp from sun damage, called actinic keratosis. These are precancerous spots that we treated with freezing. You also have harmless waxy spots on your back (seborrheic keratosis) that need no treatment. The spot on your cheek where a skin cancer was removed in 2021 looks healed and fine. To help prevent more spots, use sunscreen SPF 30 or higher every morning on your scalp, face, ears, and hands, and reapply every two hours when working outside. Wear a wide-brimmed hat and long sleeves for extra protection. Put petroleum jelly on the treated spots if they feel sore. If any spot does not heal in six weeks or starts to grow, call us. Return in six months for a full skin check.
